caveats: MyceliumSeg is cross-sectional: no ordered frames, no dish identity, no capture interval (Gate C, notes/provenance.md).
Errors are predicted-minus-reference on the de-duplicated held-out labeled masks; they describe this segmenter on this release, not a population of plates.
Boundary features are weak by construction (published Boundary IoU 28.60%, #28) and are measured at the 900-px working width; they carry the boundary error budget, not the size budget.

Candidate protrusions are radial boundary excursions of the mask, not biological hyphal tips; their false-event rate is reported, and no tip, branching, nuclear, causal or physical-growth claim is made.
The test and conditions hold-outs are not independent: ten PDA conditions images are byte copies of ten labeled-GL test images (#23), so de-duplication removes the conditions copies.

protrusion_params.detector: radial boundary excursion (outermost radius per 5-degree sector vs +-15-degree moving-average baseline)

repeatability.note: no ordered frames exist (Gate C), so a frame-to-frame repeatability SD is not estimable; the single-measurement log-area SD below is the noise floor a future ordered sequence would have to clear
